links.comparator_used: Extraction output for all reports without a certainty threshold (full coverage)
links.effect: Accuracy rose to >90% with certainty thresholds, while coverage fell to <50%
links.tradeoff: Coverage rate dropped to <50%, so over half of classifications fell below the threshold and would need other handling.
links.quote: Setting certainty thresholds further improved accuracies to >90% but reduced the coverage rate to <50%.

links.outcome: Classification accuracy across five open-source LLMs
links.effect: Default prompts: 59.23–72.86% accuracy; adapted prompts that better explain classification tasks: 64.71–85.32%
links.quote: Adapting prompts to better explain classification tasks improved performance for all models, with accuracies of 64.71–85.32%.
